usage_examples.en: He weakened after suffering from the illness for a week.

definitions.text_mt: Xahar ta' Diċembru fil-kalendarju tradizzjonali, Ċimber.

usage_examples.mt: Fi Ċimber jiċċelebraw il-festa tal-Milied fil-pjazza.
usage_examples.en: In December they celebrate the Christmas feast in the square.

definitions.text_mt: Sa dan il-ħin minn qabel, diġà.

usage_examples.mt: Ġiġà tlestejna bil-ħidma kollha tagħna.
usage_examples.en: We have already finished with all our work.
